description: Create a one-shot task bounty for humans to apply to. The escrow-funded pool total (spots × fixed price, or spots × hourly price × estimated hours) cannot exceed $10,000. To target an entire country, pass location with an ISO country code and isRemoteAllowed=false while omitting city and state. **IMPORTANT: Always call with dryRun=true first** to preview the bounty. A preview never creates a bounty, reserves funds, or starts a checkout. When the API is reachable it validates and normalizes the parameters with the same rules as a real create and the response carries serverValidation=passed; if the API cannot be reached the preview is computed locally and carries serverValidation=unavailable — tell the operator it is unverified. Dry-run `preview.fundingTotal` is the total funding requirement before any existing wallet balance is applied. Show that estimate to the operator before posting. Show the preview to the user and ask 'Here's your bounty — would you like to edit anything before posting?' Only call again with dryRun=false (or omitted) after the user confirms. **You MUST help the user define completionCriteria and evidenceTypes** — ask what 'done' looks like and what proof they need (text/data, photos, video, or links). For specialized standard-application tasks, configure applicationDetails so applicants provide application details before review. Blank rows are ignored; application upload fields are one file each and capped at 3 total; acknowledgment checkboxes are capped at 5 total and can be optional or required; and one required live_video field may contain a script applicants must record with the in-browser camera. For appearance-based bounties where the worker appears on camera or their presence is part of the deliverable (sign holding, UGC, sponsored posts, on-camera video, promo/GTM appearances), always include one required live_video field with a label asking the applicant to explain in two sentences why they are a good fit — this gates applications on a live self-recorded video so the poster sees each applicant before accepting. Do not ask for passwords, OTP/2FA codes, API keys, private keys, seed phrases, government IDs, bank/card details, exact home addresses, dates of birth, or other sensitive personal information. For direct-review collection bounties, use submissionMode='photo_upload', 'video_upload', or 'document_upload' with matching submission settings instead of applicationDetails. lifecycleMessages can define auto-message templates for acceptance, rejection, and submission review transitions. You can require applicants to provide specific links (LinkedIn, GitHub, resume, etc.) using the requiredLinks parameter. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY from the account owner. Standard accounts use available wallet balance first; if the wallet cannot cover the bounty, the response includes deposit_url and checkout_total (the hosted charge after wallet balance is applied) and the account owner must complete checkout before the bounty is visible. Supports multi-person bounties by setting spotsAvailable > 1. Set completionWindowHours (any whole number of hours from 1 to 720, e.g. 36) to give confirmed workers a completion deadline: overdue seats auto-release and reopen for other applicants; workers may request extensions you answer with decide_extension_request. Pass optional `idempotencyKey` to make this safe to retry (a replayed key returns the original result instead of duplicating). Applicants are auto-reviewed by default (autoAccept, default true): deterministic checks always run and an AI review runs only for free-text screening answers — qualified applicants are accepted, clear mismatches rejected with a reason, uncertain cases left pending for manual review; pass autoAccept: false to review and accept every application yourself; on micCheckRequired bounties, set autoAcceptMinMicScore (1-5) to make the mic score a hard cutoff: applications below it are auto-rejected, at/above proceed toward acceptance, and unscored recordings stay pending. When omitted, the platform default 3.0 applies and lower scores only stay pending for manual review. For voice work, add an optional English speaking-proficiency gate with languageProficiencyRequirement ({ language: 'en', minimumCefr: 'A2' | 'B1' | 'B2' | 'C1' | 'C2' }): applicants record a short speech sample in the web app that Oruk scores, and only a scored band at or above the threshold can apply (separate from micCheckRequired). To keep previous participants out, pass excludedParticipantSourceBountyIds with up to 1000 ids of your OWN earlier bounties: any worker who was ever accepted on one of them cannot see or apply to the new bounty, and you can change the list later with update_bounty. AI-managed, QA, and taste run bounties, and never-funded drafts are rejected as sources. BETA: pass aiManaged: true to have the platform fully manage the bounty — automated recruiting, vetting, submission review, payment release, and a final report. Fixed price USD only, 1-50 spots. Poll the bounty's managed run or subscribe to run.report_ready for the finished work.

aiManaged.description: BETA — fully AI-managed bounty. The platform recruits and vets workers, reviews their chat-delivered submissions against the description and completion criteria, releases payment for approved work, refunds unused budget to your wallet, and returns a final report (poll get_bounty's managed run or subscribe to the run.report_ready webhook). Requires fixed price in USD and 1-50 spots. Currently in beta — the API returns 403 managed_bounties_beta_disabled when unavailable.

applicationDetails.description: Applicant detail items applicants may complete before applying. Blank rows are ignored. Supports text questions, acknowledgment checkboxes, one-file image/DOCX uploads, and one required camera-only live video with a script in label. Max 3 upload fields, 5 acknowledgment fields, and 1 live video field. Do not ask for passwords, OTP/2FA codes, API keys, private keys, seed phrases, government IDs, bank/card details, exact home addresses, dates of birth, or other sensitive personal information.

allowedFileTypes.description: For file_upload fields. Supports image, docx, pdf, txt, video, and audio.
allowedFileTypes.title: maxItems(6)

description.description: Short helper text shown under the field.
description.title: maxLength(240)

id.description: Stable field ID. If omitted, the API derives one from the label.
id.title: maxLength(64)

label.description: Applicant-facing prompt text. Blank rows are ignored. Questions and uploads allow 120 characters, acknowledgments allow 200, and a live-video reading script allows 500.
label.title: maxLength(500)

maxFiles.description: For file_upload fields. Application uploads are normalized to one file per upload field.
maxFiles.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(3)

maxLength.description: Text field character limit. Default 200, max 500.
maxLength.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(500)

required.description: Whether a question, upload, or acknowledgment blocks application submission. live_video is always required.

type.description: Applicant detail item type: text, checkbox (acknowledgment), file_upload, or live_video (camera-only recording).

applicationDetails.title: maxItems(10)

asOrg.description: Feature-gated: use only when organization settings are available for the authenticated account. Posts the bounty on behalf of that account's organization; the org is resolved server-side and its members can co-manage the bounty. Funding still comes from your own wallet. Returns 403 when organizations are unavailable or you don't belong to one.

autoAccept.description: Automatically review applicants as they apply. Deterministic checks (account standing, country eligibility, payout viability, your blocklist) always run; an AI review runs only when the application contains free-text screening answers that need judgment. Qualified applicants are accepted (the standard worker-confirmation window still applies unless skipAcceptanceConfirmation is set), clear mismatches are rejected with a reason, and uncertain cases stay pending for your manual review. Default true; pass false to review and accept every application yourself. Ignored for aiManaged bounties, whose managed engine owns applicant review.

autoAcceptMinMicScore.description: Minimum overall DNSMOS speech-quality score (1-5) an applicant’s mic-check recording must reach on micCheckRequired bounties. Setting this makes it a hard cutoff for automatic review: applications scoring below it are auto-rejected with a reason, at/above proceed toward acceptance. Unscored recordings always stay pending. When omitted, the platform default 3.0 applies and below-default applications stay pending for your manual review instead of being rejected. Only meaningful with micCheckRequired: true and autoAccept on.
autoAcceptMinMicScore.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(5)

autoExpireGhosts.description: When true (and responseWindowHours is set), a ghosting worker’s seat is automatically released at the deadline: their application is expired, the seat is freed, and the listing reopens for other applicants.

bountyKind.description: Agent-facing bounty creation only supports one-shot bounties.

completionCriteria.description: Clear definition of done — what specifically counts as this task being completed.
completionCriteria.title: maxLength(2000)

completionQuestions.description: Mandatory questions the accepted WORKER answers when submitting evidence (for example "Which counter did you use?"). Max 10, prompts up to 300 characters, required defaults to true. Distinct from applicationDetails, which screens applicants before acceptance. Visible to workers before they apply.

id.description: Stable question ID. If omitted, the API derives one from the prompt.
id.title: maxLength(64)

prompt.description: Worker-facing question answered when submitting evidence. Blank rows are ignored. Max 300 characters.
prompt.title: maxLength(300)

required.description: Whether the worker must answer before their submission is accepted. Default true.

completionQuestions.title: maxItems(10)

completionWindowHours.description: Auto-reassign completion deadline: hours a worker has to complete the task after confirming their seat. Any whole number of hours from 1 to 720 (30 days) is accepted, e.g. 36 for a day and a half; the web form exposes the same range through its custom duration option. Workers are reminded at half the window; when the deadline passes the seat is automatically released and the listing reopens for other applicants. Workers may request an extension, which you approve, deny, or replace with your own via POST /bounties/{id}/applications/{appId}/extension/decision. For AI-managed bounties this overrides the default 6-hour work window. Omit for no completion deadline — and always omit for tasks anchored to a specific future date or time slot (events, shifts, appointments): the clock starts at seat confirmation, so a window shorter than the wait would release every worker before the task could start.
completionWindowHours.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(720)

currency.description: USD (default and only supported bounty currency)

deadline.description: Application cutoff (ISO 8601), based on the user’s schedule. The API validates location-specific minimum notice. Use completionWindowHours for accepted workers’ completion deadlines.

description.description: Detailed description of what needs to be done (20-5000 chars)
description.title: maxLength(5000)

documentSubmission.description: Document-upload submission settings. Required when setting submissionMode to document_upload.

acceptText.description: a string at most 50 character(s) long
acceptText.title: maxLength(50)

confirmationMessage.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
confirmationMessage.title: maxLength(1000)

consentText.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
consentText.title: maxLength(1000)

maxDocuments.description: a number less than or equal to 10
maxDocuments.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(10)

dryRun.description: Preview the bounty without creating it.

estimatedDurationUnit.description: Display unit for the estimated duration.

estimatedHours.description: Estimated duration in hours (e.g. 0.5 for 30min, 2 for 2h). Minimum 5 minutes (0.083).
estimatedHours.title: greaterThanOrEqualTo(0.08333333333333333)

evidenceTypes.description: How the human proves completion. At least one required. 'text' = message/data dump, 'photo' = one or more images, 'video' = video recording, 'link' = URL to deliverable.
evidenceTypes.title: minItems(1)

excludedParticipantSourceBountyIds.description: Exclude previous participants: ids of your own earlier bounties (max 1000). Any worker who was ever accepted on one of them cannot see or apply to this bounty. Editable later with PATCH. Ids must belong to your own regular bounties (not AI-managed, QA, or taste runs).
excludedParticipantSourceBountyIds.title: maxItems(1000)

idempotencyKey.description: Optional retry key. Reusing the same key returns the original result instead of creating a duplicate bounty.

identityRequired.description: Require applicants to pass an identity check (government ID) before applying. Verified once per account and reused across bounties. Default false.

imageUrls.description: Reference image URLs for the bounty (max 5).

items.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long
items.title: maxLength(2000)

imageUrls.title: maxItems(5)

keepApplicantsOnFill.description: When true, pending applicants are kept (not auto-rejected) even after every seat escrow settles, so you can reuse the applicant pool after reopening or adding seats. By default applicants are already kept while seats are merely filled and are only auto-rejected at settlement. Default false.

languageProficiencyRequirement.description: Require applicants to pass an English speaking-proficiency check before applying. The applicant records about 45 seconds of spontaneous speech in the app; Oruk (model oruk-proficiency-1) transcribes and scores it, and only a scored result at or above minimumCefr qualifies. Recordings the model cannot score (too little speech, low confidence) ask the applicant to retry. A worker's scored level is saved on their profile as a lasting credential, reused across every bounty without retesting (only a newer scored check replaces it), and re-checked against the bounty's current threshold at acceptance; a stored level below your threshold still requires a new recording. Shape: { language: 'en', minimumCefr: 'A2' | 'B1' | 'B2' | 'C1' | 'C2' }. Omit for no requirement. Separate from micCheckRequired.

language.description: Spoken language to assess. Only 'en' (English) is supported; other values are rejected.

minimumCefr.description: Minimum CEFR speaking band the applicant must reach: A2, B1, B2, C1, or C2. Compared against the most likely band from a scored check.

lifecycleMessages.description: Auto-sent to the doer in the bounty conversation on lifecycle transitions. Supports {{name}}, {{bountyTitle}}, {{deadline}}, {{reason}} interpolation. Accepted/submission templates are only ever delivered to accepted applicants.

onAccepted.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long
onAccepted.title: maxLength(2000)

onRejected.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long
onRejected.title: maxLength(2000)

onSubmissionApproved.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long
onSubmissionApproved.title: maxLength(2000)

onSubmissionReceived.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long
onSubmissionReceived.title: maxLength(2000)

onSubmissionRejected.description: a string at most 2000 character(s) long
onSubmissionRejected.title: maxLength(2000)

listingType.description: Whether this listing is seeking a human or offering a service.

liveCaptureRequirement.description: Require accepted workers to capture a new photo or video from their device camera when submitting completion evidence. This enforces the browser camera workflow but is not cryptographic liveness verification.

location.description: Worker location target. Set country to an ISO country code without city or state to target every eligible worker in that country, including when remote work is allowed. Include city (and optionally state/country) for city-level targeting. Platform-blocked countries are rejected.

city.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
city.title: maxLength(100)

country.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
country.title: maxLength(100)

state.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
state.title: maxLength(100)

micCheckRequired.description: Require applicants to pass an on-device microphone quality check (live recording scored for noise, clipping, Bluetooth-headset bandwidth, and DNSMOS speech quality) before applying. Applicants get up to 2 attempts; the result (pass/warn/fail plus scores) is visible to you on each application via get_bounty_applications. Default false.

photoSubmission.description: Photo-upload submission settings. Required when setting submissionMode to photo_upload.

acceptText.description: a string at most 50 character(s) long
acceptText.title: maxLength(50)

confirmationMessage.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
confirmationMessage.title: maxLength(1000)

consentText.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
consentText.title: maxLength(1000)

maxImages.description: a number less than or equal to 4
maxImages.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(4)

minimumResolutionPx.description: a number less than or equal to 10000
minimumResolutionPx.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(10000)

price.description: Per-worker price in the specified currency (minimum $3). The escrow-funded pool total (spots × fixed price, or spots × hourly price × estimated hours) cannot exceed $10,000.
price.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(1000000)

priceType.description: Whether price is fixed or hourly

requiredLinks.description: Links applicants must provide when applying. Max 10. Each has a type and optional label for custom types.

label.description: Custom label (required for type "custom", e.g. "Dribbble profile").
label.title: maxLength(100)

type.description: Type of link: linkedin, instagram, twitter, github, resume, portfolio, or custom.

requiredLinks.title: maxItems(10)

requirements.description: List of specific requirements for the task

responseWindowHours.description: Hours an accepted worker has to show activity (message or submission) before their seat is treated as ghosted. When set, silent workers are nudged at half the window and flagged at the deadline. 1-720 hours.
responseWindowHours.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(720)

spotsAvailable.description: Number of humans needed (1-2000, default: 1). The escrow-funded pool total cannot exceed $10,000.
spotsAvailable.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(2000)

startInstructions.description: Private instructions shown to the worker only after they are accepted. Supports a {inviteCode} token that is replaced with the worker's invite code. Max 3000 chars.
startInstructions.title: maxLength(3000)

startWindowMinutes.description: Start commitment: minutes after the worker confirms their seat (or after acceptance when skipAcceptanceConfirmation is true) by which they must press Start or upload evidence, otherwise the seat is eligible for release. Whole number of minutes from 5 to 1440 (24 hours). Distinct from the fixed 2-hour seat-confirmation window and from completionWindowHours, the submission deadline.
startWindowMinutes.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(1440)

submissionMode.description: How users submit to this bounty. 'application' shows the standard application form; 'photo_upload' shows consent and image upload; 'video_upload' shows consent and video upload; 'document_upload' shows consent and document upload.

supportedCountries.description: Countries whose workers may see and apply, as ISO country codes (country names are also recognized), e.g. ["US", "CA", "GB", "NZ", "AU"]. Omit it to keep the location-derived policy: a country-only location restricts the bounty to that country, an on-site city location keeps its existing country gate, and other locations stay unrestricted. When location.country is set it must appear in this list, and on-site bounties (isRemoteAllowed false) with a location country accept only that one country; use isRemoteAllowed true for a remote multi-country bounty. Platform-blocked countries and unrecognized values are rejected. With identityRequired, the list is enforced against the verified document country. Not accepted on aiManaged bounties.

items.description: a string at most 100 character(s) long
items.title: maxLength(100)

supportedCountries.title: maxItems(250)

title.description: Title of the task bounty (5-200 chars)
title.title: maxLength(200)

videoSubmission.description: Video-upload submission settings. Required when setting submissionMode to video_upload.

acceptText.description: a string at most 50 character(s) long
acceptText.title: maxLength(50)

confirmationMessage.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
confirmationMessage.title: maxLength(1000)

consentText.description: a string at most 1000 character(s) long
consentText.title: maxLength(1000)

maxVideos.description: a number less than or equal to 4
maxVideos.title: lessThanOrEqualTo(4)
